contactCta.title: Still have questions?
contactCta.subtitle: Our customer support team is available 7 days a week to help you and answer all your questions within 24 hours.

1.question: How do I create an account on Jommba?
1.answer: To create an account, click the 'Sign up' button at the top right. Then fill out our detailed form with honest information about your profile, what you're looking for, and your religious expectations. Signing up takes less than 3 minutes.

2.question: Is sign-up really free?
2.answer: Yes, creating a profile, searching for matches, and receiving visits/likes are completely free. You can use the core features with no time limit. A paid Premium Pass is available to unlock unlimited messaging.

3.question: Can I delete my account at any time?
3.answer: Absolutely. Whether you've found your other half or simply wish to leave the platform, you can permanently delete your account from your account settings. All your personal data will be erased immediately.

1.question: Why is my profile pending validation?
1.answer: To ensure a trustworthy environment and prevent fake profiles, every sign-up and every photo is manually reviewed by our moderation team. This process usually takes between 1 and 12 hours.

2.question: What are the rules regarding photos?
2.answer: Photos must be decent and comply with Islamic standards (visible face, appropriate attire). Jommba offers a unique blurring option: you can choose to blur your photos for all members and only reveal them to people you're seriously talking with.

1.question: How do I contact a potential match?
1.answer: When you visit a profile you're interested in, you can send a 'Like' or start a conversation by message if they've liked you back. Premium members can send messages directly without waiting for a match.

2.question: Can I involve my guardian (Wali) in the conversation?
2.answer: Yes, Jommba encourages family involvement. You can add your guardian's (Wali) email address so they receive notifications and can take part in or supervise the conversation as part of a calm, respectful dialogue.

1.question: What are the benefits of the Premium Pass?
1.answer: The Premium Pass lets you send unlimited messages, see exactly who liked or visited your profile, hide your photos from unregistered users, get the verified profile badge with priority, and enjoy a weekly visibility boost.

2.question: Are subscriptions commitment-free?
2.answer: Yes, our subscriptions are monthly with no long-term commitment. You can cancel automatic renewal at any time with one click from your billing settings, at no extra cost.

1.question: How does Jommba protect my data?
1.answer: All your login data and messages are end-to-end encrypted (SSL). We never share your data with third parties and we don't display any ads on our platform. Your privacy stays private.

2.question: How do I report inappropriate behavior?
2.answer: If you notice disrespectful or suspicious behavior, immediately click the 'Report' button on the user's profile or in the chat window. Our moderators will take priority action to suspend malicious profiles.
